description: This PHP class implements a serializer cache for HTMLPurifier's definition cache, providing methods to add, set, replace, get, remove, flush, and clean up serialized cache files, as well as generate file and directory paths based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Serializer
classes.description: A class that manages serialization-based caching of HTMLPurifier definitions, handling file storage, retrieval, and cache maintenance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache if it passes type check and the file does not already exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache, overwriting if necessary, after type check.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing cache file with a new definition if the file exists.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves and unserializes a definition from the cache based on configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cache file corresponding to the configuration.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Deletes all cache files in the cache directory.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes old cache files based on custom logic.

methods.name: generateFilePath
methods.description: Creates the file path for a cache file based on configuration.

methods.name: generateDirectoryPath
methods.description: Creates the directory path for cache files based on configuration.

methods.name: generateBaseDirectoryPath
methods.description: Creates the base directory path for cache storage, defaulting to a constant if not specified.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Writes data to a file and sets permissions if specified.

methods.name: _prepareDir
methods.description: Ensures the cache directory exists and has proper permissions.

methods.name: _testPermissions
methods.description: Checks and attempts to set directory permissions to ensure writability.
